build.justification: SETUP-00 has no product build target; its tooling is standard-library Python.

e2e.justification: No Gate 0 runtime exists; control-plane lifecycle cases are counted as integration.

lint.justification: No linter is vendored; compilation and diff checks are recorded.

security.justification: Lesson validation does not recursively scan every field and accepts unresolved preventive controls/evidence.

documentation.justification: Lesson provenance and CP-0006 sealing chronology contain correctness-affecting inaccuracies.

greenKeeper.justification: The Green Keeper accepts an empty mandatory gate selection and emits a vacuous PASS.

deliveryCompleteness.justification: 55/59 checklist requirements are COMPLETE; four are PARTIAL.
